seedQualification: Real-driver audit: two viewer plays and two viewer challenges, full winner reached with the default four-seat roster and safe-view opponent policy.
input: Godot Input.parse_input_event mouse motion/press/release on the transformed center of actual grouped Buttons

stages.expect: Recipient hand is concealed in presentation state and real face/label bindings.
Reveal displays exactly the authority recipient's own cards; no event is emitted.
Actual card input selects the first own card without changing authority.
Cover removes private faces/labels and selection without an authority event.
Foreground loss conceals and disables interaction; return never auto-reveals.
Actual Play emits a revision-bound intent and disables submission until a newer authority view.
Only actual authority challenge proof and penalty are displayed.
Actual Continue advances the authority and conceals the newly dealt hand.
The viewer's actual Challenge button emits an accepted authoritative challenge.
Bounded real game progression reaches an authority-selected winner.
If shown, the actual confirmation requests native lobby navigation.
A new root, presentation identity, gate and authority launch start concealed before actual Leave.

comparison: Both full matches must have identical safe authority-view SHA-256 values at every revision, including the initial launch.
limits: Desktop rendering/bridge/input evidence only; no multiplayer, Android/iOS embedding, hardware performance or native accessibility claim.
